steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What will you do with me?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Nothing. You keep staying here.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Until your client contacts you? When will that be? Do we just keep waiting until they make contact?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Any other questions?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No, that's all.
You return to the kitchen.
You do have another question, one that someone has asked you, and you've asked her.
User_W21: Why would Fish listen to you? Maybe there's something special about you?
Yes, you've earned her trust, and you take care of the chores and handpick orders for her. Yet, you have no idea why she trusts you.
You dive into your memories to find the day when things began to change...

It was the third day after you were kidnapped, and you were starving. You sneaked into the kitchen in the early morning, only to be caught red-handed by your "roommate" as you were about to pick up a kitchen knife.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I was just looking for something to eat. I didn't mean to grab this.
She stares at you in silence.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...I haven't eaten for two days. I'm really hungry.
After a silence that feels like a lifetime, she finally speaks.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I'm hungry too.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Do you cook?
You've only ever made instant noodles at the Bureau, but you feel it's best to keep that to yourself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I do. What would you like?

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Red bean soup.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I like hot red bean soup.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: Thank you.

It was from that moment things began to change. You started with small tasks like cooking and cleaning, slowly making your way into her life while cautiously testing her limits. Eventually, you began picking orders for her, but you never dropped your guard.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you sure you want my help? I am your captive, after all.
Angell answers without even looking up.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I'm not losing anything here. I took the job just to make a living.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: And nothing you do could pose a threat to me.
But when it comes to either waiting out the danger or risking it, you always choose the latter.
